chunks: This is Jesus, son of Mary: A true account they contend about.
ai.seo_question: What is the meaning of 'Qawl al-Haqq' in Surah Maryam regarding Jesus?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse serves as a definitive rebuttal to the Christian doctrine of the Trinity, affirming Jesus as a revered human prophet and the 'Word of Truth' rather than divine offspring. It underscores the continuity of monotheistic revelation, positioning the narrative of Mary and Jesus within the broader Islamic testimony of God's absolute unity (Tawhid) against those who dispute His singular nature.
